clips.title: The story
paras: Harpies Threaten is a Horde quest offered by Maggran Earthbinder at Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains. Fulfilling the tauren calling as stewards of the land, adventurers are directed west into the devastated Charred Vale to cull the surging ranks of the Bloodfury harpy coven.

The tauren of Sun Rock Retreat hold a profound duty to safeguard Stonetalon, maintaining natural balance and shielding peaceful travelers from the region's hazards. Maggran Earthbinder, the elder leader of the retreat, observes with growing alarm the relentless rise of the local harpy population. The Bloodfury coven has spread across the scorched wastes of the Charred Vale, harassing passing beasts and choking off travel routes. Left unchecked, their predatory flocks threaten to isolate Sun Rock Retreat entirely.

West of Sun Rock Retreat lies the Charred Vale, a desolate wasteland of ash, scorched earth, and smoldering trees left behind after catastrophic fires. Here, nesting high in the charred remnants of ancient woods, the Bloodfuries have established a stronghold. Maggran tasks Horde warriors with venturing into this hostile caldera to cull dozens of harpy ambushers, slayers, and roguefeathers. Thinning the flock shatters the immediate grip the coven holds over the vale and clears the path to confront their matriarchal lineage directly.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Tauren take pride as the protector of these lands. Undoubtedly you can guess why I am alarmed with the number of harpies that dwell here in Stonetalon.
The Bloodfuries are the source of the increasing number of harpies in Kalimdor; they encroach upon all likes of life preventing the innocent from leaving their boundaries.
I need you to cull the harpies, friend!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do not be weary of Charred Vale; many evil creatures reside in those hills. Stay strong friend, and you shall prevail over this threat to our people. Go now and strike hard - our children shall never know of the evil of what was.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is most excellent news! Tell me again how you cast fear into the cold hearts of those vile harpies. The Bloodfuries have been dealt a serious blow!
